newsitem.title: USA: First Shenango to start self tender offer.
newsitem.headline: First Shenango to start self tender offer.

text.p: First Shenango Bancorp Inc said on Thursday it plans to commence tommorow a self-tender offer for the purchase of up to 200,000 common shares, or about 8.86 percent, of its 2.258,047 common shares outstanding.

The offer will allow shareholders to specify prices for the shares as long as it is not greater than $23.75 per share and not less than $20.50 per share. After the company receives its tenders, it will select a single price at which it can buy 200,000 shares, First Shenango said.
The tender offer will expire on Nov. 25, the company said.
